The Monty Hall problem is a famously counterintuitive probability puzzle: after picking one of several doors, the host opens the other doors to reveal goats behind all but one — should you switch to that last remaining door, or stay with your original pick? The app below lets you play it yourself, run thousands of simulated rounds, and see why switching wins far more often than intuition suggests.
